entries.name: Traffic light
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours (Kenney City Kit Roads)

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Substitutes for the plan row (Quaternius traffic light via poly.pizza, which is blocked): Kenney City Kit Roads traffic-light-hanging (GLB; the kit also has a plain pole traffic-light and a lone horizontal head, traffic-light-object-horizontal). The head is VERTICAL (red top, amber, green bottom), Western style; a Japanese signal is horizontal on the arm, so it is not a Japanese street signal as is. Pole 5 m to the top of the head, arm 2.9 m. Kenney orange housing and grey pole recoloured to pale aluminium (Japanese poles), visors navy. No script has green: in indigo the stop lamp is accent red, the caution lamp practical amber, and the go lamp is moon (pale blue-white), which reads as a lit pale lamp, not green; a film that needs a green or Japanese ao lamp must remap the go role. maxColors 48 keeps every colormap texel apart (at 12 or 24 the small green lamps merged into grey). Static, no clips.
